title: [Master] - Move Expense Agent (Preview) app into BCApps
summary: The Expense Agent (Preview) app source is moved into BCApps as a W1 app with country apps for AT, AU, CA, DE, DK, ES, FR, GB, NZ and US. It covers expense reports, approvals, an agent with Copilot capability, and API pages.
key_points: Brings the Expense Agent (Preview) app and its country-specific event subscriber apps into BCApps
Includes about 40 API pages for expenses, expense reports, lines, attachments, projects and setup
Adds tables, pages and posting codeunits for expense reports, approvals and posted reports
Ships permission sets for the agent and for Expense Management admin, edit and read access
Includes agent consumption tracking, KPIs, and email retrieval with task scheduling
